{{Quote|The Isards make their own luck.|Armand Isard|<ref name="IAD">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''Isard family''' was a wealthy and influential family of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], some members of which played prominent roles in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One of them, [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], served as [[Director of Republic Intelligence]]<ref name="dbst" /> and remained in post as [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] when the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the Empire.<ref name="xwing" /> When he was sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|117|Isard, Armand}}</ref> Isard was initially replaced by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal]],<ref name="gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> but his daughter [[Ysanne Isard]] ended up occupying the post.<ref name="xwing" /> Armand Isard also had a [[Armand Isard's brother|brother]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] until he was killed during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]<ref name="AotE1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="shw">''[[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War]]''</ref>
